summary: The known_hosts module adds or removes SSH host keys in a known_hosts file, allowing one entry per key type per host; useful before git over SSH, while template suits very large key sets.
questions: How do I add a server's SSH host key to known_hosts with Ansible?
How do I pre-trust GitHub's host key before cloning?
What's the best way to manage hundreds of host keys?

answer_card.title: Manage SSH known_hosts
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.known_hosts` adds/removes host keys from a `known_hosts` file (one entry per key type per host since 2.2). Handy before using `git` over SSH. For very large numbers of keys, use `template` instead.
